description: This file defines the ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException class, a custom exception used to indicate invalid connection configurations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with detailed context.

classes.name: ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating invalid connection configuration, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ConnectivityException.

classes.name: ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException with a specified error message.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
